title: Runs from halted configurations
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, let $O$ be a language over its symbol alphabet, and let $c$ be a configuration with $k+1$ work tapes whose state is absent. For every natural number $n$, running $M$ relative to $O$ for $n$ steps from $c$ leaves the configuration equal to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle machine $M$ with $k$ ordinary work tapes
An oracle language $O$ over the symbol alphabet
